andythraxx-mining.summary: ANDYTHRAXX MINING makes videos about adjusting gold recovery equipment. Its sluice demonstrations explain how water flow, box angle and trough setup change the way material moves through the system.

adventure-gold.summary: Andrew Smith, known as Adventure Gold, has shared his experiences prospecting in New South Wales. His recorded conversation with Flash In Your Pan introduces his work to prospectors outside Australia.

sources.title: Flash In Your Pan interview with Andrew Smith

alan-robertson.summary: Alan Robertson documents beach prospecting in Washington, including a trip to Cape Disappointment. His channel also explores stream sluices, gravel screening and making silicone sluice mats.

sources.title: Alan Robertson’s Washington beach prospecting video

california-mother-lode-prospectors.summary: California Mother Lode Prospectors records outings with fellow gold seekers in California. The videos follow the search in the field and show what prospectors see when they check their pans.

sources.title: California Mother Lode Prospectors’ video collection
California Mother Lode Prospectors’ panning outing

canadian-gold-mining.summary: Canadian Gold Mining shares field videos about searching for placer gold. In one creek sampling episode, the creator pans material at regular intervals to see how gold concentrations vary along the stream.

sources.title: Canadian Gold Mining’s creek sampling video

chasing-gold-australia.summary: Josh of Chasing Gold Australia appears in Australian goldfield outings around Ballarat. In published collaborations, he joins other prospectors in the field and helps newcomers try detecting for natural gold.

sources.title: Pete’s Gold Adventures’ Ballarat outing with Chasing Gold Australia
DirtFishMish’s first goldfields outing with Josh

crux-prospecting.summary: Crux Prospecting publishes guides to highbanker setup, water pumps and sluice matting. Its video collection brings together field demonstrations from several prospectors who use Crux equipment.

sources.title: Crux Prospecting’s video collection and setup guides

dave-mccracken.summary: Dave McCracken and The New 49’ers share written gold panning instruction and field demonstrations. Their resources cover the basics of working a pan, and their videos follow prospectors as they sample for gold.

diggin-for-gold.summary: Diggin’ For Gold shares Australian gold prospecting outings and workshop projects. The videos pair time in the field with practical toolmaking, including a demonstration of how to make a detecting pick.

sources.title: Diggin’ For Gold’s detecting pick project
Diggin’ For Gold’s Australian prospecting outing

dirtfishmish.summary: DirtFishMish shares metal detecting trips on land, at the beach and underwater. In one Australian goldfields video, the creator tries detecting for natural gold with guidance from other prospectors.

dons-mining-office.summary: Don’s Mining Office collects firsthand mining stories and articles about mine exploration, gold panning and assaying. The site also preserves accounts of people and places connected to mining history.

flash-in-your-pan.summary: Ed Marvin’s Flash In Your Pan pairs conversations with working prospectors with stories from American gold rush history. Episodes explore places such as Dahlonega, Pike’s Peak and the Black Hills.

sources.title: Flash In Your Pan interview with Andrew Smith
Flash In Your Pan’s video collection

gerrys-detectors.summary: Gerry’s Detectors shares field videos of prospectors using metal detectors to search for gold nuggets. The channel includes outings with models such as the Garrett Axiom and Minelab GPX 6000.

sources.title: Gerry’s Detectors team and official channel link

glacial-gold-hunter.summary: Lucas Lundgren’s Glacial Gold Hunter explores gold left by glaciers in the Midwest. The channel also documents panning around Nome, Alaska, and covers what happens when gold concentrates are smelted.

gold-cube.summary: Gold Cube University shows how to set up and use the Gold Cube recovery system. The demonstrations cover assembling the stand, connecting a pump and battery, and cleaning out the concentrate.

gold-digger-nz.summary: Gold Digger NZ documents river prospecting and equipment tests in New Zealand. The videos show how prospectors move large rocks to reach the material underneath and test suction on a dredge setup.

sources.title: Gold Digger NZ’s river rock video
Gold Digger NZ’s dredge suction test

gold-fever-adventures.summary: Gold Fever Adventures covers how prospectors look for deposits and work around bedrock. The video collection also follows the cleanup stage, including a demonstration on separating black sand from concentrate.

sources.title: Gold Fever Adventures’ black sand separation demonstration

gold-hog.summary: Doc’s Gold Hog videos demonstrate gold panning and fine gold recovery. They cover reading creeks, separating gold from black sand, and finishing a pan of concentrates.

sources.title: Gold Hog on panning and black sand cleanup

goldsnoop.summary: Vivien Laïlle’s GoldSnoop collects reading and videos in French on gold prospecting and mining history. The videos range from a homemade rock crusher to a lecture on ancient European gold mining.

goldbay.summary: Goldbay’s videos explore gold mining, cleanup, and specimen collecting. The channel includes footage from a Colorado quartz mine and close looks at crystalline gold specimens.

golden-submarine.summary: Golden Submarine posts gold panning outings and gear trials in French. The videos include a trip with Jan the Prospector and a brief test of a compact sluice.

sources.title: Golden Submarine’s panning outing with Jan

golden-triangle-prospecting.summary: Golden Triangle Prospecting films tests of a gold cradle, also called a rocker box. One episode shows how the cradle is used at Slatey Creek.

sources.title: Golden Triangle Prospecting’s first cradle test
Golden Triangle Prospecting’s second rocker box test

green-mountain-gold-trap.summary: Green Mountain Gold Trap shares instructions and demonstrations for its river prospecting equipment. Joseph, the maker, explains how to adjust the water flow and clean out the removable capture tray.

sources.title: Green Mountain Gold Trap product instructions
Joseph’s Green Mountain Gold Trap development notes

have-a-go-prospecting.summary: Andrew’s Have A Go Prospecting videos follow outings on the south coast of New South Wales. Episodes cover looking for alluvial gold, metal detecting, and exploring the ground around old mines.

sources.title: Have A Go Prospecting’s official site

prospector-nic.summary: Prospector Nic’s How to Find Gold channel follows field searches for gold along rivers. Episodes include a jungle prospecting trip and a search for gold left behind by earlier miners.

sources.title: How to Find Gold with Prospector Nic

i-brake-for-bedrock.summary: I Brake For Bedrock films metal detecting outings focused on gold nuggets and other finds. The channel includes searches for new nugget patches and clips about artifacts encountered while detecting.

sources.title: I Brake For Bedrock’s nugget patch outing
I Brake For Bedrock’s detecting outing

krazynutz.summary: KRAZYNUTZ shares outings and prospecting gatherings through the Hooterhills site and YouTube channel. Videos feature trips to Deadman’s Hollow and events such as the Gatesville Gold Nugget Shootout.

kevin-singel.summary: Kevin Singel’s Finding Gold in Colorado guidebooks and articles cover prospecting techniques and the state’s mining history. His site also shares a short panning demonstration and guides to gold rush ghost towns.

sources.title: Finding Gold in Colorado’s panning guide
Finding Gold in Colorado’s ghost town guide

lxr-postal-prospecting.summary: LXR Postal Prospecting reviews bags of paydirt ordered from different sellers. The videos follow the panning process and show what turns up in the pan.

liz-kreate.summary: Liz Kreate documents trips to look for gold and gemstones and shows how she turns some finds into jewelry. Her videos include introductions to finding gold and searching for peridot.

sources.title: Liz Kreate’s introduction to finding gold

mbmmllc.summary: Jason Gaber’s Mt. Baker Mining and Metals channel follows mine exploration and ore processing. Its videos trace steps from taking bulk ore samples to smelting and refining the recovered metal.

sources.title: Mt. Baker Mining and Metals channel
Jason Gaber’s bulk sampling and refining video

mad-scientist-prospecting.summary: Mad Scientist Prospecting documents field outings and experiments with prospecting tools. The videos include a search through loose gravel and an outing that puts a kitchen wok to work.

sources.title: Mad Scientist Prospecting’s loose gravel outing

mantis-gold-mining.summary: Based in Colorado, Mantis Gold Mining supplies placer prospecting gear, including sluices, highbankers, and pans. Its site also publishes equipment notes, including a post about fluid bed gold traps.

sources.title: Mantis Gold Mining’s gold trap notes

michigan-prospectors.summary: Troy now publishes as The Nomadic Prospector, previously Michigan Prospectors. His channel follows searches for gold, rocks, minerals, and fossils and covers the tools he tries and builds for those outings.

misha-boylan.summary: Misha Boylan covers prospecting in California’s Mother Lode. Videos include a highbanker trial in a seasonal creek and a search for gold along a river.

sources.title: Misha Boylan’s seasonal creek highbanking trial

mrdazp1.summary: MrDazP1 documents gold prospecting trips in Wales and Scotland. Videos show how he samples stream gravels, pans for gold, and tries sluicing and underwater searches during river outings.

sources.title: MrDazP1’s Scottish sluicing and sniping outing

northeast-prospecting.summary: Northeast Prospecting films gold outings in different conditions, including winter trips with The Rookie Miner. The channel also shares field footage from Reedy Creek.

sources.title: Winter prospecting with The Rookie Miner

northern-pickers.summary: Northern Pickers shares recreational gold prospecting in Scotland, with videos of panning trips and seasonal nugget searches. The outings show what the crew brings back to the pan.

nugget-noggin.summary: Nugget Noggin covers gold prospecting and metal detecting, with river hunts for rings, jewelry, and other lost objects. His videos follow the searches and show the items he recovers.

outback-gold-fever.summary: Krissy of Outback Gold Fever documents gold prospecting trips through the Australian outback, including Western Australia. Her field videos follow detector signals, nugget hunts, and the work of digging targets.

prospection-de-loisir.summary: Prospection de loisir publishes French language guides and field videos about gold panning, metal detecting, and magnet fishing. The site covers practical techniques, equipment, and rules for the hobbies in France.

rob-parsons.summary: Rob Parsons combines gold prospecting with wilderness exploration and mining history. His videos visit old gold workings and follow field clues as he investigates where the gold might have come from.

rookie-gold-prospector.summary: Rookie Gold Prospector’s earlier channel description focused on introducing gold prospecting in Pennsylvania and Ohio. The linked YouTube channel now appears under a different name, Gold is where you find it.

sources.title: Earlier description of the same YouTube channel

sluice-goose.summary: John Richmond’s Sluice Goose content focuses on the Goldrop, a device designed to separate gold from paydirt. The company shares a demonstration that uses fine flour gold.

snake-river-products.summary: Snake River Products publishes demonstrations of its gold recovery gear, including sluices and the Pyramid Pro pan. The videos show different ways the equipment is set up and used.

steve-herschbach.summary: Steve Herschbach writes practical guides to metal detecting and gold prospecting at DetectorProspector. His articles explain how to choose coils, tune detector settings, and test performance in different ground conditions.

tassie-boys-prospecting.summary: Levi Triffitt films gold prospecting trips into Tasmania’s wilderness for Tassie Boys Prospecting. His videos explore creeks, bedrock crevices, and old workings while following the journey into remote country.

the-uranium-hunter.summary: The Uranium Hunter explores mineral geology through field trips and written accounts. A series on the Cheviot Hills compares old survey reports with observations of rocks and streams to investigate possible gold mineralization.

tony-ledford.summary: Tony Ledford works with the Buckeye Chapter of the Gold Prospectors Association of America on prospecting education. His sessions for Scouts cover panning, sluicing, mineral identification, and Ohio mining history.

tyler-mahoney.summary: Tyler Mahoney teaches alongside Ted Mahoney through The Prospectors Club. Their paid video course covers detector settings and coils, reading geological maps and historic workings, and field methods such as sampling and dryblowing.

walk-about-prospecting.summary: Walk About Prospecting shared videos on sluicing and highbanking. The channel was featured in the Goldfields Guide’s roundup of prospecting creators in the Victorian goldfields.

washington-beach-mining.summary: Washington Beach Mining is a video series about prospecting for gold along Washington’s coast. An earlier episode follows Alan Robertson’s search for beach gold over two days.

sources.title: Washington Beach Mining two-day field video

ghost-town-living.summary: Brent Underwood documents the restoration of Cerro Gordo, a historic mining town in California. Ghost Town Living follows the work above ground and explores what remains of the town’s former mines.

sources.title: Cerro Gordo’s history and Ghost Town Living
Ghost Town Living’s mine exploration video

gold-putz.summary: Gold Putz shares prospecting trips in Colorado alongside paydirt reviews. The creator’s background page describes prospecting in urban Denver creeks and designing tools for gold recovery.

nugget-shooterette-expeditions.summary: Tammy films Arizona gold outings that include nugget detecting and drywashing. She also shows how she works through drywasher concentrates with a sluice or a gold wheel.

american-gold-prospectors.summary: American Gold Prospectors films and interviews people looking for gold. Field episodes follow prospectors as they work through boulders, clean out promising spots and try different sluice mats.

sources.title: American Gold Prospectors’ boulder moving and mat test

that-prospectors-life.summary: That Prospectors Life covers gold prospecting and placer mining in Nevada, California, and Alaska. The channel films river outings and shows techniques such as sniping and working bedrock for gold.

al-gold-prospecting.summary: al gold prospecting shares gold panning and metal detecting outings in Alabama and Georgia. The channel also covers rockhounding and shows how collected gemstones can be cut.

inside-bend-prospecting.summary: Inside Bend Prospecting follows gold searches in southern Oregon and beyond. The channel covers panning and sluicing as well as checking bedrock crevices and searching underwater.

sources.title: Inside Bend Prospecting’s Oregon sluicing and panning outing

jacobs-brand-gold-prospecting.summary: Jacobs Brand Gold Prospecting documents prospecting and small mining projects in Arizona and Idaho. The videos cover panning, highbanking, drywashing, and setups that recirculate water.

sources.title: Jacobs Brand Gold Prospecting’s official site

alaska-gold-hunter.summary: Alaska Gold Hunter records panning trips and visits to mining areas, including Hatcher Pass. The videos cover the practical side of outings, such as changing plans when water levels rise.

jprad-prospecting.summary: Jonathan’s J’Prad Prospecting channel covers gold panning, rockhounding, and equipment reviews from a New England perspective. The videos include a series on panning Tom’s Gold Dirt.

sources.title: J’Prad Prospecting’s Tom’s Gold Dirt series

petes-gold-adventures.summary: Pete’s Gold Adventures films prospecting in central Victoria, including creek panning and searches for gold in quartz. The channel also covers making and testing equipment for crushing gold ore.

out-bush-gold-hunter.summary: Out Bush Gold Hunter documents gold prospecting with a pan, a highbanker, and metal detectors. The channel covers both processing stream gravel and searching for gold with a detector.

sources.title: Out Bush Gold Hunter YouTube channel

shaneoz-gold-rush.summary: Shane’Oz Gold Rush shares detecting outings and camping in Victoria’s Golden Triangle. The videos include nugget searches with the GPX 6000 and a visit to the Wedderburn Detector Jamboree.

nuggethunting.summary: Nuggethunting focuses on metal detecting for gold nuggets. Its field videos show detectors in use and discuss equipment, with several examples featuring the Nokta Magnetar 9000.

colorado-gold-camp.summary: Colorado Gold Camp explores placer and lode gold prospecting, metal detecting and mineral collecting. Its field videos include outings in Colorado and a closer look at prospecting around bedrock.

sources.title: Colorado Gold Camp’s bedrock prospecting video

nick-molnar.summary: Nick Molnar shares gold panning from Ontario, including a look back at the gold he panned over a season and a walkthrough of a kit for getting started.

chercheurs-dor-du-quebec.summary: chercheurs d’or du Québec documents recreational gold panning in French. The channel takes viewers along on Québec prospecting outings, including a filmed trip with Gabriel.

sources.title: chercheurs d’or du Québec on YouTube
